title: Quang Ngai in a day
summary: A day on the Trà Khúc, don where the river meets the sea, then Sơn Mỹ. Mỹ Khê at Cổ Lũy, 12 km east, is the afternoon sand, and it is not the beach in Đà Nẵng. On Friday, Saturday, Sunday, and holidays the night street on Tôn Đức Thắng runs 17:00–22:00.

stops.name: Tra Khuc
stops.note: Walk the Trà Khúc bank, and on Friday, Saturday, Sunday, and holidays Phố đêm Sông Trà runs 17:00–22:00 on Tôn Đức Thắng.

stops.name: Don
stops.note: Eat don in the morning or the evening, and in May and June go to the river mouth at the end of Trường Sa.

stops.name: Son My
stops.note: Give the late morning to the memorial at Tịnh Khê.

seoTitle: Quang Ngai in a day — river, Son My, My Khe
seoDescription: One day in Quang Ngai: the Trà Khúc, don, and Sơn Mỹ. Mỹ Khê at Cổ Lũy is the afternoon sand. The weekend night street is 17:00–22:00.
